env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# The copy rule is stated where users look for it.
logos help eject
stdout 'version-control-ignored'

cd m
[git] exec git init
[symlink] symlink link.txt -> data.json

logos run .
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt

logos eject -o out

exists out/main.go
exists out/go.mod
exists out/sub/s.go

# Non-source files ride along: the ignore file itself, data files, and a
# package note. data.json proves the copy is byte for byte.
exists out/.gitignore
exists out/README.md
exists out/data.json
cmp data.json out/data.json
exists out/sub/note.md
exists out/testdata/t.txt
exists out/vendor/extra.txt

# Dot-prefixed and underscore-prefixed paths are copied: //go:embed
# reaches them, so dropping them would break the ejected build.
exists out/.h.txt
exists out/_u.txt

# Paths a version-control ignore file lists are still copied: eject
# reads no ignore file. The ignored note is embedded, so the ejected
# build fails without it.
exists out/ignored/note.txt
exists out/.outline/notes.md
exists out/_ignored/u.txt
exists out/frontend/node_modules/pkg/index.js
exists out/.references/plain.txt
exists out/.references/loose/data.txt

# A directory that holds its own go.mod is another module and stays
# out, including one nested under testdata. .git contents, symlinks,
# and special files stay out too.
! exists out/foreign
! exists out/foreign/go.mod
! exists out/testdata/nested
! exists out/.references/clone
! exists out/.git
[symlink] ! exists out/link.txt

cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cp stdout $WORK/ejected.txt
cmp $WORK/native.txt $WORK/ejected.txt

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/ejectcopy

go 1.27
-- m/main.lgo --
// Command ejectcopy pins the eject copy rule: every regular file of
// the main module is copied, including dot-prefixed,
// underscore-prefixed, vendor, testdata, and ignored paths.
package main

import (
	_ "embed"
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ejectcopy/sub"
)

//go:embed ignored/note.txt
var note string

//go:embed _u.txt
var u string

//go:embed .h.txt
var h string

func main() {
	fmt.Print(note)
	fmt.Print(u)
	fmt.Print(h)
	fmt.Println(sub.Msg())
	fmt.Println("copy rule")
}
-- m/sub/s.lgo --
package sub

// Msg reports the subpackage string.
func Msg() string {
	return "sub-ok"
}
-- m/sub/note.md --
sub note
-- m/README.md --
copy rule readme
-- m/data.json --
{"copy": true}
-- m/testdata/t.txt --
kept
-- m/vendor/extra.txt --
vendored data
-- m/.h.txt --
dot data
-- m/_u.txt --
underscore data
-- m/ignored/note.txt --
ignored note
-- m/.gitignore --
.references/
.outline/
frontend/node_modules/
_ignored/
ignored/
-- m/.outline/notes.md --
local notes
-- m/_ignored/u.txt --
ignored underscore data
-- m/frontend/node_modules/pkg/index.js --
console.log("node");
-- m/.references/plain.txt --
plain reference
-- m/.references/loose/data.txt --
loose reference data
-- m/.references/clone/go.mod --
module example.com/cloneforeign

go 1.27
-- m/.references/clone/c.go --
package clone
-- m/foreign/go.mod --
module example.com/foreign

go 1.27
-- m/foreign/f.go --
package foreign
-- m/testdata/nested/go.mod --
module example.com/testdata-nested

go 1.27
-- m/testdata/nested/inner.go --
package inner
